learning_extracted: A consumer that reads the NORM of a representation can be input-independent even when the vector carries the signal. Test the statistic the consumer actually reads (here R^2(norm -> distance) ~0 at every checkpoint while R^2(vector -> distance) 0.07-0.34).

Pick the stream by what it carries: the sensory harm stream z_harm_s already carries proximity (R^2 0.57-0.76, norm 0.42-0.66 at init) while the affective stream carries body damage. A threat-entry consumer wired to z_harm_a is a stream-choice defect (SD-011 / SD-020 / MECH-258 contract).

A 'life ceiling' probe must include the degenerate policies the agent actually uses. Here the tax-free wall-press policy lives to the cap, while forced-move oracles cap at ~16 (red-team F1; the draft's 'BOTH forced by construction' was wrong and is withdrawn).
An untrained-vs-trained representation comparison must be PAIRED (same env seeds and scripted actions), and a decodability bar must be normalised by the input ceiling measured on the same sample.
A dead-unit fraction is only a training finding if it moved from init: 47% was already 46% untrained.

A selection-layer veto cannot reach behaviour through a latched commitment. Record beta state, committed step index and committed-trajectory identity on every tick of any veto test (the entropy precondition alone does not detect a 100%-occupied latch).

RECORDING gaps: the commit-latch state per tick; the training-time freeze_active / MECH-357 suppression counts (the 'trained under lock' premise could not be measured); trained z_harm_s (weights not saved).
